resources.string: Delete account
This cannot be undone. Your account and its data are deleted and you are signed out.
What is deleted
The account, your e-mail and name, and any identity details you entered
Your academy account and lesson progress, where it was created with the same e-mail
Your exchange UID and exchange API keys
Notification preferences and token
Saved signal history and price alerts
What is kept
Trading records, as far as law or the exchange contract requires
Security and anti-fraud logs, for at most 12 months
Both are kept anonymised — no e-mail, name or UID — and are no longer attributable to you.
What is not deleted
Your account at the exchange. That account is yours; Pro CHart neither created it nor can close it.
DELETE
Type “%1$s” to confirm.
Delete account
The account was not deleted. Try again, or contact support.
This service does not offer in-app deletion yet. The route below works today.
Delete from outside the app
The deletion page sets out the steps and the timescales, and does not require signing in.
Open the deletion page
Copy the page link
The link is on your clipboard. Open it in a browser on a computer or any other device.
Retention and deletion are set out in full in the privacy policy, section 5.
Privacy policy
What stays on this phone
Your trading journal and your paper trades
Watchlists, chart layouts, templates and the drawings on your charts
Price alerts that run on this phone itself

None of this has ever been on a server, so deleting the account does not remove it. Your name, picture and description are cleared by the sign-out that follows deletion. To remove the rest, uninstall the app or clear its data from Android settings.
